name: Skills Lab: browse a seeded skill and an agent's linked skills
description: M2 Skills, read-only on seeded data. Loads /skills, opens the seeded pr-quality-rubric and sees v5 on its Config tab; opens Preview (the prompt block as the agent receives it) and Versions (the v5 note and the v1 note); then opens the seeded Security Reviewer's Skills tab and sees 3 of 6 enabled (server seed). Creates, saves and attaches nothing, and calls no LLM.
